name: Wedwood Chronicles
overview: After spending his childhood as an overlooked orphan in the human world, twelve-year-old Orin Blackwood is summoned to the legendary Wedwood Academy to claim his birthright within the Fire Kingdom. As he navigates a treacherous social hierarchy dominated by elite elemental royals and learns to bond with a chaotic dragon. Orin discovers that his arrival has awakened an ancient, forbidden magic. While he and his newfound friends, the loyal Jax and the brilliant Lia, struggle to survive deadly creature attacks and grueling trials, they remain unaware that the greatest threat to the Four Kingdoms is hidden in plain sight. The season follows their journey from outcasts to heroes, culminating in the terrifying realization that one of their own is the destined heir to the Shadow—a power capable of rewriting reality itself.
